scripts.preinstall: node -e "const agent=process.env.npm_config_user_agent||'';const exec=process.env.npm_execpath||'';if(agent&&!/pnpm/i.test(agent)&&!/pnpm/i.test(exec)){console.error('Design Blend uses pnpm. Enable it with: corepack enable pnpm');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --filter "./workers/**" --if-present run typecheck
